overview: Roadie Roster is a new-store opening staffing app that tracks hired roadies from kiosk sign-up through paperwork, orientation, training groups and certification, with demo mode and a store-local pretend clock.
features: Kiosk sign-up and manager approval of new roadies
Roster, roadie trading cards and derived stage tags
Paperwork checklists with optional short labels for step tags
Orientation sessions, training groups and trainer check-ins
Dashboard with hiring progress, countdown and opening timeline
Demo mode with a pretend date driven by a single store clock
